description: The server offers a package and sends only half of its file, then nothing more. The client is stopped while it downloads. Stop cancels the download at once (and the partial file goes): the client must have let go of it by the time it says it has stopped, and stop must end within its bound. The driver lingers after stop, so a download left running shows.

offer.name: held
offer.content: a file the server sends half of, then nothing more
